bottom_line: This year's event raised $1,150 for the town library.

headline.dek: 320 visitors, 58 loaves, and a winning loaf of 4.6 kg.
headline.title: A record loaf at the Fallowfield bake-off

scenes.question: How big was the bake-off?
scenes.why: Two numbers are the news: the weight of the winning loaf and the crowd it drew.

scenes.question: Is the bake-off growing?
scenes.why: Three years of entries, one measure over time — the growth is the story.

data.speaker: Priya Raman
data.text: I kneaded it for an hour. The secret is a slow rise.

scenes.question: What is the secret?
scenes.why: The winning baker's own words: an hour of kneading and a slow rise.
